description.sr:
Napiši funkciju `promiseAll(promises)` koja radi kao `Promise.all`, bez njegove upotrebe.

- vraća promise koji se razrešava nizom rezultata, **istim redosledom** kao ulaz
- ulaz može sadržati i obične vrednosti, ne samo promise-e
- prazan niz se razrešava praznim nizom
- čim jedan promise bude odbijen, rezultat se odbija istom greškom
description.en:
Write a function `promiseAll(promises)` that works like `Promise.all`, without using it.

- returns a promise that resolves to an array of results in the **same order** as the input
- the input may contain plain values, not only promises
- an empty array resolves to an empty array
- as soon as one promise is rejected, the result is rejected with the same error

text.sr:
Deklaracija funkcije `promiseAll`. Radi isto što i ugrađeni `Promise.all`: čeka sve promise-e i vraća njihove rezultate.

- Promise je „obećanje rezultata koji još nije stigao“. Može biti u tri stanja: čeka (*pending*), uspeo je sa vrednošću (*fulfilled*), ili je odbijen sa greškom (*rejected*).
- `promises` je niz promise-a, ili običnih vrednosti.
- `{` otvara telo; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 13.
text.en:
Declaration of the function `promiseAll`. It does the same as the built-in `Promise.all`: it waits for all promises and returns their results.

- A promise is a “promise of a result that has not arrived yet”. It can be in three states: waiting (*pending*), succeeded with a value (*fulfilled*), or rejected with an error (*rejected*).
- `promises` is an array of promises, or of plain values.
- `{` opens the body; it is closed by `}` on line 13.

text.sr:
Vraćamo novi promise koji sami razrešavamo kad budemo spremni.

- `new Promise(...)` pravi promise. Prima funkciju koja se zove „executor“ i dobija dve funkcije: `resolve(vrednost)` ispunjava promise, a `reject(greška)` ga odbija.
- Executor se izvršava ODMAH i sinhrono, čim se promise napravi.
- Promise se menja samo jednom: svaki kasniji poziv `resolve` ili `reject` se ignoriše. Zato nije problem ako ih više promise-a pokuša da odbije.
- `(resolve, reject) => {` otvara telo executor-a; zatvara ga `});` u liniji 12.
text.en:
We return a new promise that we resolve ourselves when we are ready.

- `new Promise(...)` creates a promise. It receives a function called the “executor” and is given two functions: `resolve(value)` fulfills the promise and `reject(error)` rejects it.
- The executor runs IMMEDIATELY and synchronously, as soon as the promise is created.
- A promise settles only once: every later call of `resolve` or `reject` is ignored. So it is not a problem if several promises try to reject it.
- `(resolve, reject) => {` opens the executor body; it is closed by `});` on line 12.

text.sr:
Prazan niz u koji ćemo upisivati rezultate.

- `const results = [];` pravi prazan niz. `[]` je prazan niz.
- Rezultati će u njega ulaziti na mesto koje odgovara redosledu ulaza, ne redosledu kojim stižu.
text.en:
An empty array into which we will write the results.

- `const results = [];` creates an empty array. `[]` is an empty array.
- Results will go into it at the place that matches the order of the input, not the order in which they arrive.

text.sr:
Brojač promise-a koji još čekaju.

- Na početku čekaju svi, pa je to `promises.length` (dužina niza).
- `let` jer se vrednost smanjuje svaki put kad neki promise stigne.
- Kad brojač dođe do `0`, svi su gotovi.
text.en:
A counter of promises that are still pending.

- At the start all of them are pending, so it is `promises.length` (the length of the array).
- `let` because the value decreases every time a promise arrives.
- When the counter reaches `0`, all of them are done.

text.sr:
Poseban slučaj: prazan ulaz.

- `remaining === 0` je tačno samo kad je niz prazan.
- Kad nema nijednog promise-a, nijedan `.then` ispod se nikad neće izvršiti, pa bi naš promise ostao večno nerazrešen (*pending*).
- Zato ga odmah razrešavamo praznim nizom `results`, što test traži.
text.en:
A special case: an empty input.

- `remaining === 0` is true only when the array is empty.
- When there are no promises at all, no `.then` below would ever run, so our promise would stay unresolved forever (*pending*).
- So we resolve it right away with the empty array `results`, which the test requires.

text.sr:
Prolazimo kroz svaki element ulaza.

- `promises.forEach(...)` poziva funkciju za svaki element niza.
- `(p, i)` su parametri te funkcije: `p` je element (promise ili obična vrednost), a `i` je njegov indeks (0, 1, 2...). Indeks nam treba da rezultat stavimo na pravo mesto.
- `=> {` otvara telo; zatvara ga `});` u liniji 11.
text.en:
We go through every element of the input.

- `promises.forEach(...)` calls the function for every element of the array.
- `(p, i)` are the parameters of that function: `p` is the element (a promise or a plain value), and `i` is its index (0, 1, 2...). We need the index to put the result in the right place.
- `=> {` opens the body; it is closed by `});` on line 11.

text.sr:
Čekamo rezultat tog elementa.

- `Promise.resolve(p)` pretvara bilo šta u promise: ako je `p` već promise, vraća ga; ako je obična vrednost (npr. `3`), pravi već razrešen promise. Zato ulaz sme da sadrži i obične vrednosti.
- `.then(onFulfilled, onRejected)` prima dve funkcije: prva se poziva kad promise uspe (linije 7 do 10), druga kad ne uspe (`reject` u liniji 10).
- `(value) => {` je prva funkcija, a `value` je rezultat promise-a.
- Funkcije u `.then` se uvek pozivaju tek posle sadašnjeg koda, čak i za već razrešen promise.
text.en:
We wait for the result of that element.

- `Promise.resolve(p)` turns anything into a promise: if `p` is already a promise it returns it; if it is a plain value (e.g. `3`) it creates an already resolved promise. That is why the input may contain plain values too.
- `.then(onFulfilled, onRejected)` receives two functions: the first is called when the promise succeeds (lines 7 to 10), the second when it fails (`reject` on line 10).
- `(value) => {` is the first function, and `value` is the result of the promise.
- Functions in `.then` always run only after the current code, even for an already resolved promise.

text.sr:
Upisujemo rezultat na njegovo mesto.

- `results[i] = value` stavlja vrednost na indeks `i`, a ne na kraj (`push`).
- Promise-i se ne razrešavaju redom: spori promise na prvom mestu može da stigne poslednji. Rezultat ipak mora da bude u redosledu ulaza, a to garantuje upis po indeksu.
- JavaScript dozvoljava upis na indeks veći od trenutne dužine; praznine se popune kad stignu ostali rezultati.
text.en:
We store the result in its place.

- `results[i] = value` puts the value at index `i`, rather than at the end (`push`).
- Promises do not resolve in order: a slow promise in first place may arrive last. The result must still be in the order of the input, and writing by index guarantees that.
- JavaScript allows writing at an index larger than the current length; the gaps are filled when the other results arrive.

text.sr:
Proveravamo da li je stigao poslednji rezultat.

- `--remaining` je prefiksno smanjenje: `--` znači „oduzmi 1 od promenljive“. Prvo smanji `remaining` za 1, pa vrati novu vrednost.
- `=== 0` pita da li je brojač sada nula, tj. da li su svi stigli.
- Ako jeste, razrešavamo ceo promise nizom rezultata.

Tok za `promiseAll([Promise.resolve(1), spori, 3])`, gde spori promise daje `2` posle 20 ms:

```
početak:                          results = [],         remaining = 3
element 0 (Promise.resolve(1)):   results = [1],        remaining = 2
element 2 (obična vrednost 3):    results = [1, , 3],   remaining = 1
element 1 (spori, posle 20 ms):   results = [1, 2, 3],  remaining = 0 → resolve([1, 2, 3])
```
text.en:
We check whether the last result has arrived.

- `--remaining` is a prefix decrement: `--` means “subtract 1 from the variable”. It first decreases `remaining` by 1, then returns the new value.
- `=== 0` asks whether the counter is now zero, i.e. whether all of them have arrived.
- If so, we resolve the whole promise with the array of results.

Flow for `promiseAll([Promise.resolve(1), slow, 3])`, where the slow promise gives `2` after 20 ms:

```
start:                            results = [],         remaining = 3
element 0 (Promise.resolve(1)):   results = [1],        remaining = 2
element 2 (plain value 3):        results = [1, , 3],   remaining = 1
element 1 (slow, after 20 ms):    results = [1, 2, 3],  remaining = 0 → resolve([1, 2, 3])
```

text.sr:
Kraj prve funkcije i obrada greške.

- `}` zatvara funkciju iz linije 7.
- `, reject` je drugi argument za `.then`: ako promise bude odbijen, poziva se `reject(greška)` i naš promise se odmah odbija tom istom greškom.
- Ne čekamo ostale: prvo odbijanje odlučuje (skriveni test). Kasnija odbijanja se ignorišu, jer se promise menja samo jednom.
- `)` zatvara poziv `.then(`, a `;` završava naredbu.
text.en:
The end of the first function and error handling.

- `}` closes the function from line 7.
- `, reject` is the second argument of `.then`: if the promise is rejected, `reject(error)` is called and our promise is rejected immediately with that same error.
- We do not wait for the others: the first rejection decides (hidden test). Later rejections are ignored because a promise settles only once.
- `)` closes the call `.then(`, and `;` ends the statement.

text.sr:
Zatvara funkciju za `forEach` (otvorenu u liniji 6).

- `}` zatvara telo funkcije.
- `)` zatvara poziv `forEach(`.
- `;` završava naredbu.
text.en:
Closes the function for `forEach` (opened on line 6).

- `}` closes the function body.
- `)` closes the call `forEach(`.
- `;` ends the statement.

text.sr:
Zatvara executor (otvoren u liniji 2).

- `}` zatvara telo executor-a.
- `)` zatvara poziv `new Promise(`.
- `;` završava naredbu `return`.
text.en:
Closes the executor (opened on line 2).

- `}` closes the executor body.
- `)` closes the call `new Promise(`.
- `;` ends the `return` statement.

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije `promiseAll` otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, JavaScript uopšte ne može da pročita kod (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the body of `promiseAll` opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, JavaScript cannot read the code at all (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: Rezultat se upisuje na indeks `i`, a ne sa `push`, jer promise-i ne moraju da se razreše redom.
note.en: The result is stored at index `i` instead of using `push`, because promises do not have to resolve in order.
